source: PHC Core Rules v1.0: Essence of Experience (Levels and XP); starting-kit gear and its weights (Equipment slots, item weights; provisional)

items.name: Essence of Experience
items.text: Experience sealed in mana, worth {=effects.0.value} XP. Anyone with a focus in a hand can crack it outside a fight: an Evoker, an Emanator, a Visualizer or an Attuner. They choose who absorbs it: themselves or a party member. A character can absorb {=effects.0.limit.n} per rest. On a Survival run anyone, focus or not, can consume it at a shrine's altar. It also sells well.

requires_to_use.why: Crack it with a focus in a hand: an Evoker, an Emanator, a Visualizer or an Attuner.

items.name: Stim injector
items.text: One dose. Use it on an ally next to you: it stabilises a Downed ally at 1 HP, or heals 6 × your Healing given, more as you level. It also stops Bleeding.

items.name: Field kit
items.text: Bandages, splints and a suture set. Out of a fight (not on the field after one), anyone can use it to treat {=effects.0.n} arm or leg injury on themself or a squadmate, and {=use.spend} kit is used up. Field Surgery treats with it without using it up.

items.name: Armourer's chit
items.text: A chapter armourer's stamped requisition. At a shop or a Forge it pays for one grade step to Fine or Masterwork in place of credits. Never sold; it may be given.

items.name: Ration pack
items.text: A day of food, sealed.

items.name: Evoker
items.text: Holds one mana core; the focus for Sigil magic.

items.name: Standard mana core
items.text: A core of condensed mana. An Evoker burns it for Sigils.

items.name: Sigil plate
items.text: A slate for one Sigil word. Out of a fight, read it on the Magic tab to learn the word cut into it (its note in your pack), or, on a blank plate (one bought at a shop), the word you choose of those you can learn now. The plate crumbles; one new thing a scene.

items.name: Heart plate
items.text: A violet-veined slate for one Outburst lesson: a tone (fire, storm, frost, stone, gale or acid), a school or a module. Out of a fight, read it on the Magic tab to learn the lesson written on it (its note in your pack), or, on a blank plate (one bought at a shop), the lesson you choose of those you can learn now. The plate crumbles; one new thing a scene.

items.name: Chalk and wax
items.text: For drawing sigils by hand.

items.name: Emanator
items.text: The heart link; the focus for Soul magic.

items.name: Attuner
items.text: The standard glove for Bonds and Tending: a heart that threads you to the people around you.

items.name: Visualizer
items.text: A glove with a projector set in the middle of the palm: the focus for Figments. Hold the palm out and the mana in the air builds what you picture in its light. It holds one mana core of its own.
items.source: rules 1.34 (Classes 3.0 step 8): the third standard focus (Leon, 13 Nov 2026: a glove, the projector in the palm)

items.name: Prayer beads and incense
items.text: For prayer and patience.

items.name: Torch
items.text: Lights 4 tiles around you, so darkness doesn't halve your sight there. As a weapon it hits for 12 Elemental damage (Unarmed), and a hit on a roll of 15 or more sets the target Burning. It burns for 30 minutes.

items.name: Flare
items.text: Thrown or held, it lights 6 tiles for 3 rounds and reveals anyone Hidden there. It is used up.

items.name: Spare-parts charge
items.text: One charge of parts for Field Repair and Field Surgeon's Patch: {=price_credits} credits.

items.name: Quiver
items.text: Holds {=arrows.standard} arrows at Standard, {=arrows.fine} at Fine, {=arrows.masterwork} at Masterwork, {=arrows.relic} at Relic and {=arrows.celestial} at Celestial: a quiver's grade gives arrows held and nothing else. Every archer may carry two, one worn and one ready; Switch quiver is the bow's reload. One enchantment at every grade.
items.lore: Every archer's first quiver comes with the bow.

items.name: Red dot sight
items.text: Optic: no −2 to hit in the first {=bands} range band past the weapon's effective range.

items.name: Scope
items.text: Optic: Aimed Shots with this gun get {=effects.1.value|signed} to hit (its own term, Scope) and {=bands} more range band before penalties start.

items.name: Suppressor
items.text: Muzzle: this gun's shots don't reveal you while you are Hidden. {=effects.1.value} damage to its shots.

items.name: Compensator
items.text: Muzzle: Recoil {=recoil|signed} per shot.

items.name: Extended magazine
items.text: Magazine: +{=magazine_pct}% capacity (rounded down), in every magazine of the gun.

items.name: Quick-release magazine
items.text: Magazine: reloading this gun costs {=effects.1.set} AP.

items.name: Foregrip
items.text: Underbarrel: Bursts and full auto with this gun are {=effects.1.value|signed} to hit.

items.name: Bayonet
items.text: Underbarrel: melee attacks with the gun deal {=melee_damage} damage (Dexterity) instead of your fists' damage.

items.name: Underslung launcher
items.text: Underbarrel: holds one 40 mm grenade round.

items.name: Serrated edge
items.text: Edge: critical hits with this weapon also cause Bleeding.

effects.say: {target} is cut by the serrated edge{then}.

items.name: Weighted head
items.text: Edge: {=effects.1.value|signed} damage to this weapon's blows.

items.name: Wrapped grip
items.text: Grip: you can't be Disarmed while you hold this weapon.

items.name: Sigil-etched magazine
items.text: Inscription: holds one stored Sigil spell.

items.name: Ember enchantment
items.text: Enchantment, for a quiver: every arrow drawn from it carries the Ember tone's rider at stage {=stage} (Burning, no save) and deals ×{=damage_mult} damage.

items.name: Storm enchantment
items.text: Enchantment, for a quiver: every arrow drawn from it carries the Storm tone's rider at stage {=stage} (it ignores half cover) and deals ×{=damage_mult} damage.

items.name: Frost enchantment
items.text: Enchantment, for a quiver: every arrow drawn from it carries the Frost tone's rider at stage {=stage} (Slowed unless the target passes a Body save) and deals ×{=damage_mult} damage.

items.name: Stone enchantment
items.text: Enchantment, for a quiver: every arrow drawn from it carries the Stone tone's rider at stage {=stage} (Prone unless the target passes a Body save) and deals ×{=damage_mult} damage.

items.name: Gale enchantment
items.text: Enchantment, for a quiver: every arrow drawn from it carries the Gale tone's rider at stage {=stage} (a push away from you) and deals ×{=damage_mult} damage.

items.name: Acid enchantment
items.text: Enchantment, for a quiver: every arrow drawn from it carries the Acid tone's rider at stage {=stage} (Corroded unless the target passes a Body save) and deals ×{=damage_mult} damage.

items.name: Field helmet
items.text: Head: +{=effects.0.value}% Injury resistance.

items.name: Ballistic helmet
items.text: Head: +{=effects.0.value} armour.

items.name: Night-sight goggles
items.text: Head accessory: darkness doesn't halve your sight.

items.name: Gas mask
items.text: Head accessory: toxic spills don't hurt you.

items.name: Padded undershirt
items.text: Inner torso: +{=effects.0.value} armour.

items.name: Trauma plate insert
items.text: Inner torso: +{=effects.0.value} armour.

items.name: Utility belt
items.text: Lower torso: +{=effects.0.value} kg carry limit.

items.name: Armoured belt
items.text: Lower torso: +{=effects.0.value} armour.

items.name: Armoured greaves
items.text: Legs: +{=effects.0.value} armour; {=effects.1.value} Movement.

items.name: Runner's trousers
items.text: Legs: +{=effects.0.value} Movement.

items.name: Work gloves
items.text: Hands: +{=effects.0.value} Unarmed damage.

items.name: Combat gloves
items.text: Hands: +{=effects.0.value} armour.

items.name: Field boots
items.text: Footwear: rough ground costs no extra.

items.name: Heavy boots
items.text: Footwear: +{=effects.0.value} armour; +{=effects.1.value}% Injury resistance.

items.name: Musek Blestor
items.text: A palm-sized player with a speaker that can fill a hangar. The music traits start with one. It plays your favourite song for the room: 2 AP in a fight, or once per scene outside one.

items.name: Prescription glasses
items.text: Thick lenses. The trait Bottle Butts for Eyes checks whether you are wearing them.

items.name: Smiling mask
items.text: A mask with a fixed smile. The trait The Mask checks whether you are wearing it.

items.name: Prosthetic arm
items.text: A working arm of metal and wire. An arm injury hits the metal instead: the arm goes offline (Augment Offline) until it gets a Field Repair. With Improvisation 3 it can take up to 2 mods, fitted outside a fight; the Narrator decides what each mod does on it.

items.name: Central City ID
items.text: Proof of residence in Central City.

items.name: Bank card
items.text: An account in a Central City bank.

items.name: Contraband
items.text: Something the law wants back. The Narrator decides what it is.

items.name: Grimoire
items.text: Notes in a hand older than the cover.

items.name: Toolbox
items.text: Spanners, a crimper, wire. Field Surgery counts it as a field kit, and it is never used up. It has no use of its own.

items.name: Bottle of spirits
items.text: Something strong. The Lunarshine trait counts your drinks.

items.name: Pack of cigarettes
items.text: Twenty. A carried good: nothing uses them, in a run or out of one.

items.name: Drone frame
items.text: A folding combat drone. If you are a Drone Handler, it fights beside you.

items.name: Armour-piercing rounds
items.text: Armour-piercing rounds of one calibre (bought and made for each gun's own rounds). Load them outside a fight to fill the magazine in the gun. They ignore armour and deal 20% less damage.

items.name: Hollow-point rounds
items.text: Hollow-point rounds of one calibre (bought and made for each gun's own rounds). Load them outside a fight to fill the magazine in the gun. They deal 30% more damage, but the target's armour counts double.

items.name: Incendiary rounds
items.text: Incendiary rounds of one calibre (bought and made for each gun's own rounds). Load them outside a fight to fill the magazine in the gun. A hit sets the target Burning, and they deal 10% less damage.

items.name: Enhanced rounds
items.text: Enhanced rounds for any gun. Load them outside a fight to fill the magazine in the gun. They ignore armour, deal Elemental damage, and each hit raises the mana meter by 1.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.text: A measure of propellant. With casings and an ammo maker it becomes rounds for any gun.

items.name: Casing
items.text: An empty brass casing, picked up and kept. With gunpowder and an ammo maker it becomes a round.

items.name: Mana residue
items.text: Mana left behind where a spell or a machine burnt out, caught in a vial. Pressed with any focus in hand, enough of it makes a standard core.

items.name: Ammo maker
items.text: A hand press with dies for every calibre. Between fights it turns gunpowder and casings into rounds.

items.name: Open Hand
items.text: The Open Hand, a monk's gloves (with only the family's gloves in your hands, or none). Open guard: in Light armour or none, with light gloves, blows aimed at you are at {=effects.0.value|signed} to hit. Sway (an Answer, your reaction): the first blow that lands on you in a round does ×{=effects.1.value} damage. Breath ({=effects.2.ap} AP, once a turn): end your newest Body harm and be Guarded. One attribute is enough: a glove's blows roll to hit with the better of Raw Power and Dexterity (in place of the glove's own skill, never on top). Forms on a plain blow (one a blow, never with a technique): Jab ({=toggles.0.effects.0.value|signed} AP, ×{=toggles.0.effects.1.value} damage), Palm (×{=toggles.1.effects.0.value}; a hit saves or is Staggered: no reaction until its next turn, once a turn), Sweep ({=toggles.2.effects.0.value|signed} AP, ×{=toggles.2.effects.1.value}; a hit knocks it Prone, never a Boss), Snatch (×{=toggles.3.effects.0.value}; a hit saves or drops its weapon, never a Boss). One form's hold lands a turn.

effects.say: {self} sways off the line of {actor}'s blow.

effects.label: Breath
effects.text: Once a turn: end your newest Body harm and be Guarded. Only with the Open Hand's gloves, or none, in your hands.

why.self_holds: Only with the Open Hand's gloves (or none) in your hands.

card.text: Open guard: only light gloves in hand, Light armour or none: blows at you are at {=effects.0.value|signed} to hit.

items.name: Shield follow
items.text: Follow strike: ×{=effects.1.value} of the shield's blow. On a hit, +{=effects.0.value} Guard (once a turn; twice with a shield in each hand).

items.name: Strike follow
items.text: Follow strike: ×{=effects.0.value} of the shield's blow. No Guard on a hit.

items.name: Ward (light)
items.text: Ward: each ranged or elemental hit on you while the shield is in your hand is {=effects.0.value|abs} less (none from a melee blow).

items.name: Ward (standard)
items.text: Ward: each ranged or elemental hit on you while the shield is in your hand is {=effects.0.value|abs} less (none from a melee blow).

items.name: Ward (heavy)
items.text: Ward: each ranged or elemental hit on you while the shield is in your hand is {=effects.0.value|abs} less (none from a melee blow).

items.name: Arsenal action
items.text: Central Command Arsenal: reloading this gun costs {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less.

items.name: Siege loader
items.text: With Raw Power {=effects.0.if.self_skill.raw_power} or more, reloading this tube costs {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less.

items.name: Afterword's edge
items.text: Follow strike: ×{=effects.0.value} damage. Once a turn, a follow that lands leaves Bleeding (Body save).

items.name: Assault helm
items.text: Head: +{=effects.0.value} armour; +{=effects.1.value}% Injury resistance.

items.name: Cowl
items.text: Head: others see you from {=effects.0.value|abs} tile less far.

items.name: Hood
items.text: Head: others see you from {=effects.0.value|abs} tiles less far.

items.name: Blackout hood
items.text: Head: others see you from {=effects.0.value|abs} tiles less far.

items.name: Spotter's monocle
items.text: Head accessory: +{=effects.0.value} Vision.

items.name: Sight visor
items.text: Head accessory: +{=effects.0.value} Vision.

items.name: Sealed visor
items.text: Head accessory: toxic spills don't hurt you.

items.name: Mesh undersuit
items.text: Inner torso: +{=effects.0.value} armour.

items.name: Rig belt
items.text: Lower torso: +{=effects.0.value} kg carry limit.

items.name: Field trousers
items.text: Legs: +{=effects.0.value} armour.

items.name: Tactical gloves
items.text: Hands: +{=effects.0.value} armour.

items.name: Jump boots
items.text: Footwear: +{=effects.0.value} Movement; rough ground costs no extra.
